semantics.engine: Python re; flags are Python integer flags (IGNORECASE=2, UNICODE=32, MULTILINE=8, DOTALL=16)
semantics.capture: explicit secret_group, else first nonempty capture, else full match
semantics.entropy: Shannon bits per character on selected secret; threshold inclusive
semantics.content: default reject; quarantine only with change=save; identifier fields always reject
semantics.cross_field: scan individual fields, then concatenate strings with empty and newline separators; accept joined hit only if secret capture crosses a field boundary
semantics.digest: colon-delimited lowercase hex 16..128; preserve if preceding label final word names credential; writer-owned final digest always masked; caller gets no tail exception
semantics.limitation: ordinary label before all-hex secret may be missed; browser precheck is advisory and server scanning remains authoritative; site exceptions are not published
semantics.path: record scanning never trusts client paths; file-conditioned rules do not run without a server-provided path
semantics.env_extra: skip URI without @, require ASCII letter and digit, entropy >=3.5; private-key-header always matches
